headline: Sources: Caleb Williams injury considered to have 3-4 week timeline
summary: Bears QB Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring injury that doctors consider a three-to-four-week injury, league sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

headline: Sources: Myles Garrett faces 6-week timeline from knee surgery
summary: Myles Garrett was given a six-week recovery timeline from his knee surgery, meaning the star pass rusher might not return until early November, sources told NFL Network.

headline: Cowboys, Lions Among Teams To Inquire On Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr.
summary: Recently named as a team to watch as a possible landing spot for Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr., the Lions have inquired on his availability, per ESPN’s Adam Schefter. The Cowboys, who were speculatively connected to a possible Porter pursuit, are also among the clubs to make an inquiry. More to come.
